description.description: A vertical outdoor shot shows five men standing side-by-side in front of an entrance sign for the Kirti Nagar Police Station in West District Delhi. The men are dressed in casual attire, including t-shirts and jeans or trousers. Above them, a large white sign with blue and red borders displays the police station's name in both Hindi and English. Lush green trees and a multi-story building are visible in the background.

description.description: The sequence depicts a heated physical confrontation in an outdoor setting in India. In the first frame, a woman in a grey tunic stands facing a security guard in a light blue uniform. In the second frame, the woman lunges forward and grabs the guard by his shirt collar/front, as onlookers and a police officer watch in the background. By the third frame, they are scuffling; the woman has pushed the guard back, and his foot is stepping on a yellow bag that has fallen to the ground. In the final frame, the woman physically strikes the guard near his head/neck area with her hands while he tries to block the blows.
